data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Timon', meaning 'God's protector' or 'honoring God'. The name Tymon was borne by a saint who was a shepherd in ancient Greece. The name Tymon carries the meaning “God's protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tymon usually hope their child will grow to embody god's protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Tymon's eternal message motivates us to honor God through our actions and to strive to create a loving and spiritual environment for those around us.
